note: Identity weights in bits (log2 likelihood ratio) and the rules for the Verified grade. Version 1 was the hand values of the additive score (prior chosen so +4 points reads p 0.93 and +7 reads p 0.99). Higher versions are fitted by scripts/osint/fit-weights.mjs on labelled candidates; every ledger row records the version that scored it.

fitted.method: logistic regression in bits, L2 prior sd 0.5 bits around the hand values
fitted.thresholdNote: likely = posterior above 0.5: on the labelled candidates every anchored account that was theirs scored 0.58-0.73 and no namesake scored above 0.10; verified also needs two independent sources (see weights.mjs). sd 0.5 chosen by leave-one-subject-out log loss (0.244 vs 0.253 at sd 2).
fitted.labelledFrom: 10 panel subjects (8 real, 2 synthetic), hand-checked against live sources; labels kept outside the repo
fitted.unfittedNote: link, image, place, title and handle_peer had no labelled cases in this panel (nothing fed the official-links list and no headshot match fired), so they keep their hand values; refit with scripts/osint/fit-weights.mjs once runs with those signals are labelled. The design doc proposes +6 for a close headshot hash; that is left to the fit.
